services.name: petitions
services.summary: Tiếp dân — Citizen feedback (phản ánh), the tasks that arise from it and from meeting conclusions, and their SLA. Citizen letters (`don_thu`: complaints, denunciations, proposals, requests) are NOT here — they belong to `documents` (ADR 0039).

services.name: platform
services.summary: Nền tảng — Commune registry, domains, quotas, commune lifecycle. Cross-tenant BY DESIGN; the only service besides identity with a legitimate cross-commune data area.

services.name: reporting
